summary.text: Peggy Scott is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 31B who has served in the Minnesota House since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes owning a business and working as a realtor.

paragraphs.text: Peggy Scott lives in Andover, Minnesota, and her career experience includes owning a business and working as a realtor.
Ballotpedia lists Scott's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2009, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Higher Education Finance and Policy, Judiciary Finance and Civil Law, Rules and Legislative Administration, and Ways and Means committees, and she co-chairs the Judiciary Finance and Civil Law Committee.
Earlier committee assignments listed by Ballotpedia include chairing the Civil Law and Data Practices committee in the 2015 and 2017 sessions.
